name: Ricardo Alves
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. After a career repairing consumer electronics, he felt stifled and longed for something more challenging. A chance encounter with a former racing mechanic sparked his interest, and he dedicated himself to learning the intricacies of racing electronics. He started volunteering at a local karting track, quickly proving his aptitude for diagnosing and repairing complex systems. 

Though relatively new to the professional motorsport scene, Ricardo possesses a methodical approach and an insatiable curiosity. He thrives on understanding the 'why' behind every component and system, ensuring optimal performance and reliability. He's eager to absorb knowledge and contribute to a winning team. His ambition is fueled by a desire to prove that experience and dedication can overcome a late start in the field.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: A stocky man with strong hands and a focused gaze.

quirks: Constantly chews on the end of his pen when concentrating.
Always carries a small notebook filled with circuit diagrams.
Has a habit of talking to the electronic components as he works.
